Interviewer: William A. Brower with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 117 pp.

My name is William A. Brower. It is Thursday, April 20, 2006. I’m in conducting an interview with Slide Hampton. Recording the interview is Ken Kimery. Would you start off, Mr. Hampton, by giving us your full name and date of birth?
My name is Locksley Wellington “Slide” Hampton. I was born in Jeannette, Pennsylvania, April 21, 1932.
